items.headline: OPEC+ maintains output cuts through Q4 2026 amid demand concerns
items.summary: The alliance agreed to hold existing production cuts in place, citing uncertainty around Chinese industrial demand recovery and US recession risk.

items.headline: USDA WASDE: Global wheat ending stocks revised lower on Australian drought
items.summary: August WASDE cut 2026/27 global wheat ending stocks by 4.2 Mt on reduced Australian crop estimates. Stocks-to-use ratio falls to 31.2%, a 9-year low.

items.headline: EIA: US crude inventories draw 4.2M bbl, fourth consecutive weekly decline
items.summary: Commercial crude oil stocks fell to 428.5M barrels, the lowest since February. Refinery utilization rose to 93.2% on strong summer gasoline demand.

items.headline: Gold climbs above $2,700 as dollar weakens on Fed rate cut expectations
items.summary: Spot gold rose 1.2% to $2,718/oz as Federal Reserve minutes signalled openness to a 25bp cut in November.

items.headline: Copper slides on weak China manufacturing PMI; LME stocks at 3-month high
items.summary: Caixin China Manufacturing PMI came in at 49.3 in September, missing expectations of 50.1. LME copper inventories rose 18,000t this week to 198,000t.

items.headline: Brazil sugar output accelerates; ICE raw sugar futures drop 2.3%
items.summary: UNICA data showed Brazil Centre-South sugar production up 18% year-on-year in the first half of October.

items.headline: European natural gas prices fall 4% on mild October weather forecast
items.summary: TTF front-month dropped to EUR 38.2/MWh as extended 10-day forecasts for Western Europe showed above-normal temperatures through end-October.

items.headline: India tenders for 1.5Mt urea imports ahead of Rabi season planting
items.summary: India Potash Ltd launched a 1.5 million tonne urea import tender ahead of the October-November Rabi planting season.

items.headline: Indonesia palm oil export levy cut to boost shipments; Malaysia follows
items.summary: Indonesia reduced its progressive export levy on crude palm oil by 15% effective November 1.

items.headline: Iron ore rebounds on China stimulus; steel mills restock ahead of Q4
items.summary: SGX iron ore futures rose 3.1% after China announced infrastructure investment acceleration worth CNY 500bn.

items.headline: Ghana cocoa output forecast cut 15% on Black Pod disease spread
items.summary: Ghana's Cocobod revised its 2025/26 main crop estimate to 680,000t from 800,000t due to Black Pod disease.

items.headline: USDA raises US corn ending stocks on improved yield estimates
items.summary: USDA WASDE raised 2026/27 US corn ending stocks by 55 million bushels to 2.1 billion on higher trend yields in the Corn Belt.

items.headline: Platinum deficit widens as EV catalyst demand surges; WPIC raises forecast
items.summary: WPIC raised its 2026 platinum deficit forecast to 476koz on strong demand from hydrogen fuel cell vehicles.

items.headline: Vietnam robusta crop estimate cut on drought; ICE Robusta near 5-year high
items.summary: Vietnam 2025/26 robusta coffee output forecast at 28.5 million bags, down 8% from 2024/25 due to El Nino drought.
